lesson.subtitle: Lesson 25 -- Block 5 Review -- The Welcome Party
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Marlene Landucci | Lesson 25 -- Block 5 Review

listenings.text: Good evening, everybody, and welcome to the party. My name is Giulia, and I am the manager of Hotel Firenze. Tonight there is music on the terrace, and there are drinks and small plates on the long table. You should try the cheese from Tuscany. It is amazing. Last year we had guests from twelve countries at this party, and it was a wonderful night. So please, chat with the people next to you. Ask them where they are from and what they enjoy doing. The Wi-Fi password is on the card on every table, so you can send photos to your family. The party finishes at eleven o'clock. Have a lovely evening.

Hi Marlene, it is Paul. Thank you for a great evening. I really enjoyed talking to you at the party. Your story about the trip to Rome was so funny. I laughed all night. Tomorrow I am free in the afternoon. Would you like to visit the market with me? There is a small cafe near the market, and you should try the coffee there. It is the best in the city. My battery is almost dead, so please send me a message before ten o'clock tomorrow morning. Have a good night, and see you soon.

extra_audio.text: First, you get a message: there is a welcome party at the hotel tonight. Then, at the party, you chat with a friend about the weekend. Next, you tell the story of your trip to Rome and your best memory. After that, the friend recommends a dish and you share a plate. Finally, you ask for the Wi-Fi password and you send a photo to your family.
